newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU clears Air France 1.0 bln franc aid-EU official.
newsitem.headline: EU clears Air France 1.0 bln franc aid-EU official.

text.p: The European Commission on Wednesday cleared the final, 1.0-billion-franc tranche of aid for Air France's current restructuring package, an official told Reuters.

Clearance of the aid payment, nodded through without discussion in the weekly meeting of European Commissioners, brings to an end the EU scrutiny of the French airline's 20 billion franc package from 1994.
Last July, the Commission approved the last five billion francs in the package but froze one billion pending a progress review on restructuring.

A senior Commission official said last Friday that the airline's performance was on track and that there had been no repeats of the price leadership complaints raised last year by airlines SAS, Lufthansa and KLM.
The European Court of First Instance is due shortly to hear airlines' legal complaints about the original approval itself, which, if accepted, could reopen the whole issue.
